title: ScoreResponse
description: Answer of the speech service's POST /v1/score: one verdict per expected phoneme, grouped by the words of the reference text. Carries no learner-facing prose.

thresholdsVersion.description: Version of the GOP thresholds that produced the verdicts; a verdict is only comparable with another of the same version.

text.description: The word as written in referenceText.

start.description: Character offset of the word in referenceText.

end.description: Character offset just past the word.

correct.description: True when the word has phonemes and every one of them is correct.

expected.description: espeak IPA token the reference calls for.

heard.description: When not correct: the phoneme the model found most likely in the expected phoneme's frames. Null when correct.

gop.description: Goodness of pronunciation in nats; higher is better.

startMs.description: Start of the aligned frames, from the start of the recording.
